events.body:
## Bug

`website/views/company.py:889` has `except (AttributeError, UserProfile.DoesNotExist):`, but `UserProfile` is never imported in the module. When a member has no related userprofile — the exact case this handler is meant to recover from — evaluating `UserProfile.DoesNotExist` raises `NameError: name 'UserProfile' is not defined` instead, crashing the team-members view (500).

## Repro

Load the company/organization team view where at least one member lacks a UserProfile → NameError.

## Suggested fix

`UserProfile` is defined in `website/models.py:949`; import it:

    from website.models import UserProfile

Found by static analysis (ruff F821); no star-import masks the name. AI model used in analysis: Claude Opus 4.8 (Claude Code).
